definition: שְׁלֵט verb have power, rule ( ᵑ7 Syriac; Biblical Hebrew (q. v.) late); — Pe`al Perfect 3 masculine singular ׳ שׁ Dan 3:27 , 3 masculine plural שְׁלִ֫טוּ Dan 6:25 Imperfect 3 masculine singular יִשְׁלַ֑ט Dan 5:7 , 3 feminine singular תִּשְׁלַט Dan 2:39 , 2 masculine singular תִּשְׁלַ֑ט Dan 5:16 — have power upon, ב of thing, Dan 3:27 (of fire); fall upon, assault ( ᵑ7 = פָּגַע בְּ ), ב person Dan 6:25 (of lions); subject person rule, be ruler , absolute, Dan 5:7 ; Dan 5:16 , subject kingdom, ב of earth, Dan 2:39 . Haph`el make ruler: Perfect 3 masculine singular suffix הַשְׁלְטָח Dan 2:38 ( ב person, etc.); הַשְׁלְטֵהּ v Dan 2:48 ( עַל of province).
